hero.title: A source-of-truth results surface for historical Thai Government Lottery draws
hero.description: This mock read model simulates the first production-ready results experience with recent draw cards, grouped prizes, and quick filters so the data contract is stable before live data fully replaces the fixture.

stats.label: Latest draw date
stats.hint: Newest draw currently available in the checked mock fixture.

stats.label: Tracked prize groups
stats.hint: 1st prize, front 3 digits, back 3 digits, last 2 digits, and adjacent first prize rows.

stats.label: Searchable numbers
stats.hint: Normalized prize values prepared for search, filtering, and comparison surfaces.

highlights.title: Data quality visibility
highlights.description: Each draw card carries a coverage label so missing or partially verified prize rows remain visible during seed and QA work.

highlights.title: Frontend data contract
highlights.description: The cards and tables define how draw date, draw number, grouped prizes, and status metadata must appear in the first production results surface.

highlights.title: Backend handoff
highlights.description: When `/api/draws` is fully live, the Prisma-backed response should replace this fixture without changing the page-level contract.

draws.coverage: All tracked prize groups are present in this mock draw.
Adjacent first-prize rows still need normalization in the live ingestion path.
Last 2 digits are verified, while front/back 3-digit rows still need QA review.

contractRows.purpose: Primary key used by the results page, detail routes, and API consumers.
Human-readable draw date used as the main heading and draw-level filter target.
ISO date form used for sorting, filtering, and stable API transport.
Supports compact draw identification in list and detail views.
Machine-readable state such as complete or partial for badges and filtering.
Grouped prize rows rendered inside each draw card.
Enum-backed prize type used for Prisma mapping and filter behavior.
Summarizes data completeness and QA state for each draw row.

mockNote: Mock note: when live data replaces this fixture, normalize prize-group labels consistently across import scripts, Prisma records, and API responses so frontend filters remain stable.
